basic_details.job_title: IIT Mandi Postdoctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology Mandi has invited applications for Postdoctoral Fellow positions at its C3DAR centre, open to PhD holders in Meteorology, Atmospheric Modeling, Weather Forecasting or Climate Modeling within five years of completing the PhD. The consolidated fellowship runs from ₹80,000 for a fresh PhD to ₹95,000 for PhD plus 3 years or more of relevant experience. Applications go by email, with a CV and cover letter, to [email protected] with the subject "PDF C3DAR", before 10/12/2026 (Advertisement No. IIT Mandi/PDF/2026/C3DAR/).

how_to_apply: Prepare your CV and a cover letter.
Write the subject of the email as "PDF C3DAR".
If you are employed in a Government or Quasi-Government Organization, submit your application through the proper channel.
Documents named in the notice: CV and cover letter. The notice gives no application form and no other document list.
important_instructions: Mere eligibility does not vest any right in a candidate to be called for an interview. The decision of the Institute in all matters is final. No correspondence will be entertained from candidates in connection with the selection/interview process. The Institute reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all of the advertised posts without assigning any reason. Canvassing in any manner may entail disqualification of the candidature. Candidates may approach the Chairperson of the Centre for specific clarification; contact details are on https://c3dar.iitmandi.ac.in/. Any dispute regarding the selection/recruitment process is subject to the Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Mandi, Himachal Pradesh only.

rows.details: C3DAR Centre, IIT Mandi, Kamand Campus, Distt. Mandi, Himachal Pradesh

content_sections.heading: About IIT Mandi
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Mandi is located at Kamand Campus, Distt. Mandi, Himachal Pradesh. In this notice it invites applications from candidates with an outstanding track record for positions at the level of Postdoctoral Fellow for the C3DAR centre. The Chairperson's contact details are on the C3DAR website, https://c3dar.iitmandi.ac.in/ .

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice sets two eligibility conditions for the Postdoctoral Fellow position: PhD degree holders are eligible to apply within five years after completion of their PhD. The PhD must be in the domain of Meteorology, Atmospheric Modeling, Weather Forecasting, or Climate Modeling. IIT Mandi PhD scholars are not eligible to apply for the Institute PDF. The minimum qualification and/or experience may be relaxed for candidates with outstanding credentials. Reservation and relaxations are as per GOI Norms, and preference will be given to reserve categories without compromising quality. Persons employed in Government or Quasi-Government Organizations should submit their application through the proper channel.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Accommodation: suitable campus accommodation as per IIT Norms will be provided if requested and if available. Otherwise, HRA will be paid at the prevailing rates of the fellowship amount for off-campus housing. Medical: a Postdoctoral Fellow may use outpatient facilities in the Institute Health Centre. Reimbursement of the cost of medicines in treatment is not permissible, and any outside referral is not reimbursable. Dependants, limited to the spouse and a maximum of two children, are eligible for OPD facility and medicines available at the Health Centre pharmacy. Leave: 30 days of annual leave in an academic year, earned on a pro-rata basis. A joining report must be submitted whenever leave is availed. The leave account is maintained in the schools/centres, and no encashment of unutilised leave is allowed. A female PDF may be granted maternity leave for a maximum of 03 months. Leave up to 06 weeks can be granted for miscarriage, including medical termination of pregnancy, with a proper medical certificate. Such leave can be combined with any other leave due and does not entail any loss of financial assistance. Tenure: this is purely a temporary time-bound position and is not a permanent cadre of the Institute. The maximum duration of the fellowship is up to 3 years (after annual reviews). A Research Grant of 1 lakh per year (with carryover possibilities and pro-rata basis) is mentioned, up to three years.

rows.experience: PhD + 3 yr relevant experiences or more

content_sections.heading: IIT Mandi Postdoctoral Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: Scientific Advisory and Research Support. Technology Transfer and Innovation Management. Collaboration and Outreach. Training and Capacity Building. The Postdoctoral Fellow will be attached to a research group/school/centre, not to an individual faculty, under the supervision of the research theme coordinator/chairs. Post-docs will be eligible to serve as co-guides for B.Tech and M.Sc/M.Tech projects.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Mandi Postdoctoral Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV and a cover letter. Email both to [email protected] . Write the subject of the email as "PDF C3DAR". Send the application before 10/12/2026. If you are employed in a Government or Quasi-Government Organization, submit your application through the proper channel. Documents named in the notice: CV and cover letter. The notice gives no application form and no other document list.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The Institute may call only those candidates for interview who are shortlisted based on their qualification, experience, research and publication records, Centre requirements, and interaction in the Centre. An interview will be scheduled based on the needs of the Centre. No information will be sent to candidates who are not shortlisted. The notice prints no interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Mere eligibility does not vest any right in a candidate to be called for an interview. The decision of the Institute in all matters is final. No correspondence will be entertained from candidates in connection with the selection/interview process. The Institute reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all of the advertised posts without assigning any reason. Canvassing in any manner may entail disqualification of the candidature. Candidates may approach the Chairperson of the Centre for specific clarification; contact details are on https://c3dar.iitmandi.ac.in/ . Any dispute regarding the selection/recruitment process is subject to the Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Mandi, Himachal Pradesh only.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Mandi Postdoctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed before 10/12/2026, as printed in the notice dated 26.11.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for IIT Mandi Postdoctoral Fellow at C3DAR?
faq.answer: A PhD in the domain of Meteorology, Atmospheric Modeling, Weather Forecasting, or Climate Modeling is required, and PhD holders may apply within five years after completing their PhD.

faq.question: Q3. How much is the Postdoctoral Fellow fellowship at IIT Mandi?
faq.answer: The consolidated fellowship is ₹ 80,000 for a fresh PhD, ₹ 85,000 with 1 year, ₹ 90,000 with 2 years, and ₹ 95,000 with 3 years or more of relevant experience.
